novelty_flags.label: Proposition: pair-information-insufficient
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposed insufficiency counterexample identifies no named published estimator, workflow, or paper that discards to pairwise marginals, so it does not yet refute a concrete practice.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question: explicit-sign-atlas; Theorem: exact-region-algorithm
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal omits the closest exact-elimination comparator—Collins-style cylindrical algebraic decomposition/real quantifier elimination—and must state the concrete restriction, certificate, or complexity advance beyond an unrolled fixed-dimensional CAD.

soundness_flags.label: ass:branch-continuity
soundness_flags.one_line: BC(P) assumes a full continuous semialgebraic parametrization, fixed chart inventory, and positive separation of target images, while its justification gives no primitive observable or structural condition establishing that this strong load-bearing predicate occurs in realistic laws.
